task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the play car in teal and white using the left arm, drop it in the wooden basket with curved handle, then push the wooden basket with curved handle via the right arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，用左臂将青色和白色的玩具车抬起，放入曲柄木篮中，然后用右臂推动曲柄木篮。
